lci_dataset_description: Climate change only. Background from BONSAI (not EF compliant); 52 of 177 PV input rows without a BONSAI match (transport, water, wastewater, capital goods, glass tempering) are excluded; several Chinese BONSAI producers (e.g. aluminium) lack electricity inputs. Climate-change-only projection: direct elementary flows without a nonzero source EF3.1 climate factor are omitted from this calculation input. Public-background test variant: input exchanges referencing unavailable background activities are excluded and itemized in the private audit.
